name: Margin Protection (MP)
notes: 508(h) confirmed: RMA MP page states MP is 'a privately developed product that was submitted to the FCIC Board under Section 508(h)'; developer per RMA 508(h) developer-contact list (Watts and Associates). First available 2016 crop year for corn, rice, soybeans, spring wheat in select counties. Plan 16 = MP, 17 = MP with Harvest Price Option (RMA M13 P99F-1 plan-code exhibit).

name: Stacked Income Protection Plan (STAX)
notes: NOT 508(h): created by statute in the 2014 Farm Bill (CRS R43494: 'the FCIC shall make available to producers of upland cotton the Stacked Income Protection Plan'); not on RMA's 508(h) developer list. Upland cotton only, from 2015 crop year. Plan 35 = STAX-RP, 36 = STAX-RP-HPE (RMA M13 P99F-1 exhibit). Kept for completeness as a federal supplemental area product.

name: Supplemental Coverage Option (SCO)
notes: NOT 508(h): created by statute in the 2014 Farm Bill (CRS R43494); first available 2015 crop year. Covers part of the underlying-policy deductible up to 86% on an area basis. Plan 31 = SCO-YP, 32 = SCO-RP, 33 = SCO-RP-HPE (RMA M13 P99F-1 exhibit). Kept because it is the federal analog private supplemental products layer around.

name: Enhanced Coverage Option (ECO)
notes: 508(h) confirmed: FCIC Board approved ECO under section 508(h) on 2020-08-20 (RMA ECO FAQ / PM-20-078); first available 2021 crop year. Developer per RMA 508(h) developer-contact list: Watts and Associates. Area band from 86% up to 90% or 95%, stacking above SCO. Plan codes 87 (ECO-YP), 88 (ECO-RP), 89 (ECO-RP-HPE) per RMA M13 Enhanced APP III; administered as an endorsement (no entry in 2023 P99F-1 exhibit).

name: Hurricane Insurance Protection - Wind Index (HIP-WI)
notes: NOT 508(h): developed by RMA (2018 Farm Bill hurricane-coverage mandate) and absent from RMA's 508(h) developer list. Plan code corrected to 37 (prior value 89 is ECO-RP-HPE; 37 = HIP-WI per RMA M13 P99F-1 exhibit). First available 2020; Tropical Storm option added later. Covers ~70 crops in 23 hurricane-exposed states; row-crop subset listed.

name: Post-Application Coverage Endorsement (PACE)
developer: Zea Mays Foundation (G. Schnitkey, Univ. of Illinois) with Ag-Analytics; supported by Meridian Institute/AGree, IL Corn, NCGA
notes: 508(h) confirmed (RMA PACE FAQ; farmdoc daily 2022-01-18). Developer of record per RMA 508(h) developer-contact list: Zea Mays Foundation. First available 2022 crop year for non-irrigated corn with split-applied nitrogen in 11 Midwest states. Endorsement to YP/RP/RP-HPE; plan codes 26/27/28 confirmed in 2026 ADM InsurancePlan table (A00460).

name: Whole-Farm Revenue Protection (WFRP)
notes: NOT 508(h): the 2014 Farm Bill directed FCIC to provide whole-farm coverage (CRS R43494); RMA developed WFRP as successor to AGR/AGR-Lite, first available 2015. Plan code 76 confirmed (RMA M13 P99F-1 exhibit). Kept for completeness; whole-farm rather than single-crop row-crop product.

name: Margin Coverage Option (MCO)
notes: ADDED. 508(h) confirmed: FCIC Board approved MCO under section 508(h) on 2024-05-23 (RMA MCO page / PM-25-029); announced 2025-07-03, first available 2026 crop year. Developer per RMA 508(h) developer-contact list: Watts and Associates. ECO-style area band on operating margin; endorsement to YP/RP/RP-HPE/APH in select states. Plan codes 67 (MCO-YP), 68 (MCO-RP), 69 (MCO-RP-HPE) confirmed in 2026 ADM InsurancePlan table (A00460) + AIB dropdown.

name: Trend-Adjusted APH Yield Endorsement (TA-APH)
notes: ADDED. 508(h): listed on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list as 'Trend Actual Production History' (developer iFAR). Adjusts APH yields for yield trend; first available 2012 crop year; very widely used on Midwest row crops (farmdoc daily 2023-03). Option on APH-based plans, no standalone plan code; crop/county list per ADM.

name: Downed Rice Endorsement
notes: ADDED. 508(h) confirmed: FCIC Board approved the Downed Rice Endorsement 508(h) submission (board meeting minutes no. 215, Feb 2017). Developer of record per RMA 508(h) developer-contact list: AgriLogic Consulting. Covers added harvesting expense/quality loss when rice is downed. Southern rice states; confirm counties in ADM.

name: Cottonseed Endorsement
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (Watts and Associates). Endorsement adding cottonseed coverage to upland cotton policies. Details (first year, states) to confirm in ADM.

name: Malting Barley Revenue Endorsement
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (Watts and Associates). Contract-price-based revenue coverage for malting barley layered on the underlying barley policy. Details to confirm in ADM.

name: Pulse Crop Revenue
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (Watts and Associates). Revenue coverage for pulse crops (dry peas, lentils, chickpeas). Details to confirm in ADM.

name: Peanut Revenue
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (AgriLogic Consulting). Revenue plan of insurance for peanuts (replaced APH-only peanut coverage). Details to confirm in ADM.

name: Popcorn Revenue
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (Watts and Associates); companion ARPI Popcorn also listed. Niche row crop; include/exclude downstream as needed.

name: Specialty Soybeans
notes: ADDED. 508(h): on RMA private-sector-developed plans developer list (Watts and Associates). Coverage for contract-grown specialty (e.g., food-grade/non-GMO) soybeans. Details to confirm in ADM.
